p1.title:
Un prompt no es una pregunta.
Es una orden de trabajo.
p1.desc: El capítulo 3 fue el que más reescribimos al hacer Awesome AI Bible 2026. Rol, contexto, tarea, formato, restricción: escribe los cinco y el mismo resultado vuelve la próxima vez. Esa es la diferencia entre una afición y un trabajo.

p2.title:
Por qué el gato ninja
fracasa siempre
p2.desc: Kuro es el gato ninja más torpe del pueblo. Cada misión sale mal, y sale mal justo como un niño espera. Un álbum ilustrado para 4–8 años, publicado en coreano y japonés a la vez.

p3.title:
Aprender a emprender
en un reino sin precios
p3.desc: An Introduction to ISEKAI Entrepreneurship enseña negocios sin un solo manual. Un fundador aterriza en un reino que nunca ha oído hablar de un precio fijo y construye sus mercados uno a uno.

admin.title: Admin
admin.notAdmin: Esta cuenta no tiene acceso de administrador.
admin.deleteConfirm: ¿Eliminar este libro? No se puede deshacer.
admin.titleHint: The title readers see everywhere — store, reader, receipts.
admin.authorHint: Use one consistent spelling across all books (e.g. Akira Murata).
admin.slugHint: The web address: /books/my-new-book. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
admin.coverHint: Portrait, at least 1000px tall. Shown in the store and the reader.
admin.writeHint: Write the book right here — chapters, free sample, done. No files needed.
admin.uploadHint: Have a finished EPUB or PDF? Upload it per language and press Process.
admin.chBodyPh: Write the chapter here. Blank line starts a new paragraph.
admin.formatHint: Formatting: blank line = new paragraph · # Heading · ## Subheading · **bold** · *italic* · > quote
admin.sampleHint: Readers without a purchase see only these chapters, then the paywall.
admin.contentSaved: Content saved — check it in the reader.
admin.noChapters: Write at least one chapter first.
admin.publishHint: Draft books are visible only here. Publishing lists the book in the admin catalogue and the reader; the store shelf is curated separately.
admin.ckHint: Automatic QA over the saved book — the same kind of checks KDP runs after an upload. Save your content first, then run.
admin.ckMetaOk: Details: title, author and address look good
admin.ckSlugBad: The address (slug) must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
admin.ckPriceZero: Price is 0 — the book will be subscription-only
admin.ckCoverMissing: No cover uploaded — the store and reader will show a placeholder
admin.ckCoverLoad: The cover image failed to load
admin.ckCoverSmall: Cover is small ({w}×{h}px) — at least 1000px tall is recommended
admin.ckCoverLandscape: Cover is landscape ({w}×{h}px) — book covers should be portrait
admin.ckContentNone: No content saved yet — write chapters in the studio or process an uploaded file
admin.ckMdUnbalanced: {loc} chapter {n} has an unclosed ** bold marker
admin.ckPlaceholder: {loc} chapter {n} contains placeholder text (TODO / lorem ipsum)
admin.ckLangMismatch: {loc} content doesn't look like that language — check the language tab
admin.ckSampleAll: {loc}: every chapter is in the free sample — the whole book reads for free
admin.ckSizeBig: {loc} content is large ({mb}MB) — the reader may load slowly
admin.ckPdfNote: {loc}: PDF edition — pages are checked at processing time
admin.ckConfirmPublish: The pre-publish check found errors. Publish anyway?
admin.ckConfusable: {loc} chapter {n}: "{bad}" is usually a typo for "{good}"
admin.ckSpacePunct: {loc} chapter {n} has a space before punctuation
admin.ckPairs: {loc} chapter {n} has an unmatched bracket or quote pair
